fields.note: No tourist visa for Canadians for stays of up to 30 days. From 1 January 2026 nationals of 91 listed countries must hold a visa before arrival — Canada is NOT on that list, and Canadian residence permits are separately named as exempting their holders. But PRE-REGISTRATION ON THE EASE PLATFORM IS COMPULSORY for every foreign traveller, ideally at least 5 days before travel, and the airport security tax is paid through it. Canada's travel advice calls this pre-registration an ETA: complete the online form and pay the airport security fee at least 5 days before you arrive. Yellow fever proof only if arriving from a risk country.

fields.stay: Up to 90 days in any year
fields.note: Visa-free up to 90 days in any 12-month period (Commonwealth member). One of the world's most remote destinations — limited flights via Fiji. Climate change front line — low-lying atolls at risk.

fields.cost: Free for a 30-day visit (Commonwealth fee waiver); otherwise USD 50 single entry, USD 70 multiple entry. East Africa Tourist Visa USD 100
fields.note: Rwanda grants a visa on arrival to citizens of EVERY country with no prior application, and has since 1 January 2018. Canadians get the V1 visitor visa. You can also get it in advance online through Irembo, at an immigration office or at a Rwandan mission. As a Commonwealth country, Canadians get the visa on arrival free for a 30-day visit. The East Africa Tourist Visa (class V11, USD 100) covers Kenya, Uganda and Rwanda and cannot be extended. Yellow fever proof only if arriving from a risk country.

fields.stay: 30 days, extendable by up to 30 more days
30 days on entry, extendable twice by 30 days at no cost, up to 90 days per calendar year
fields.extension: Possible — apply to the General Directorate of Migration before the end of the 30-day period; a 30-day extension can be obtained twice, to a maximum of 90 days in a calendar year

fields.cost: If you arrive by air or sea you must pay an environmental and tourism levy of 10 US dollars on arrival.  There is a departure tax of 50 US dollars for all passengers, to be paid when leaving the BVI by air.

fields.stay: Up to 90 days in Germany regardless of other Schengen stays
Officer sets at entry: 14, 30, 60, 90 or 180 days

fields.note: THIRTY days — Qatar publishes two waiver lists and Canada is on the 30-day one, not the 90-day one that covers most of Europe. Free at the port of entry. Requires 6 months' passport validity and a return or onward ticket. Health insurance recognised by Qatar's Ministry of Public Health is required to enter. Entry may be refused if the passport shows Israeli visas or stamps, or Egyptian or Jordanian stamps from an office bordering Israel.

Short trips need nothing. For 15 days or more, an e-visa is applied for online with the Serviço de Migração e Fronteiras, decided within 7 working days, and THE FEE IS PAID AT THE BORDER ON ARRIVAL, not online — which is unusual and easy to get wrong. Passport valid at least 6 months beyond the date you leave, return ticket mandatory, and proof of means of subsistence around EUR 100 a day. Yellow fever proof only if arriving from or transiting a risk country.

Visa-free 90 days. Yellow fever certificate required if arriving from a risk country. Stable democracy, one of West Africa's safer tourist destinations. Most visitors focus on Dakar, Saint-Louis, Sine-Saloum delta.

Visa on arrival (USD 80, cash) or an eVisa applied for online before travel. Yellow fever mandatory. Commonwealth member, generally stable since civil war ended. Freetown and beaches popular. Malaria prophylaxis recommended.

Non-Arab nationals cannot get a visa at the border — a visa must be obtained in advance from a Syrian embassy or consulate. A transitional government has been in place since December 2024 and land borders and airspace may close without notice. Syria's foreign ministry site is live but publishes nothing for travellers.

Canada is not on Uganda's visa-exempt list. Apply online; biometrics are captured on arrival. A yellow fever certificate is no longer mandatory for entry (Uganda notice, 2 October 2026). The East Africa Tourist Visa (USD 100, multiple entry, 90 days) covers Uganda, Kenya and Rwanda ONLY and cannot be extended once you are in the country. Uganda's '90 days approval validity' is the window in which you must travel, not the stay.

New Zealand is not on Uganda's exemption list, so apply online before travel. If you are also visiting Kenya and Rwanda, the East Africa Tourist Visa at USD 100 covers all three on multiple entries for 3 months — but it is not extendable and does not stretch to Tanzania. A yellow fever certificate is no longer mandatory for entry (Uganda notice, 2 October 2026).

Apply online before travel; biometrics are captured on arrival. A yellow fever certificate is no longer mandatory for entry (Uganda notice, 2 October 2026). The East Africa Tourist Visa (USD 100, multiple entry, 90 days) covers Uganda, Kenya and Rwanda only.

fields.apply: In advance from the nearest Yemeni embassy or consulate
fields.note: A visa must be obtained well in advance from the nearest Yemeni diplomatic mission. There is no independent visa on arrival. Register your passport if staying more than 14 days. Entry may be refused if the passport shows Israeli visas or stamps, or Egyptian or Jordanian stamps from an office bordering Israel. The Government of Canada cannot facilitate your entry or exit. Entry arrangements for Socotra differ in practice from the mainland and cannot be verified against any official portal. All governments advise against all travel to Yemen.

fields.note: New Zealand is on the Bahamian visa waiver list, for stays of up to 3 months. Passport, return ticket and proof of funds are required; work is not permitted.
fields.stay: 90 days from your arrival date in practice; officer decides

fields.note: Apply online for a single-entry tourist e-Visa, pay, receive an approval letter within about 3 days, and the visa is stamped on arrival. The visa allows a 30-day stay, counted from the date of entry. Separately there is a free e-Arrival declaration, submitted within the 7 days before arrival or on arrival. Paid look-alike sites are abundant for Cambodia — only .gov.kh domains are official.

Visa-free for up to 90 days. You must register your presence within 24 hours of arrival. Hotels and other commercial accommodation usually file the registration for you; in private accommodation, register yourself at the nearest police station within 24 hours. Missing the registration can mean fines and difficulties when you leave.

30-day visa issued on arrival, extendable to 90 — the UK is not on Palau's waiver list (only Schengen states, Russia and Taiwan are). All tourists sign the Palau Pledge; the USD 100 Pristine Paradise Environmental Fee is included in your airline ticket.

fields.extension: Possible — up to 3 months (90 days) per extension; apply to the Chief Immigration Officer / Immigration Department before the entry endorsement expires

fields.extension: Two further 30-day periods; apply at least 7 days before expiry at the Division of Immigration

fields.apply: Tourist visa issued upon arrival. Submit the Palau Entry Form at most 72 hours before departure at https://www.palautravel.pw/ (the QR code is shown at check-in and on arrival)

fields.stay: 90 days from your first entry into Denmark or another Nordic country; time spent there in the preceding half-year is deducted; this applies regardless of earlier stays in other Schengen countries
fields.note: Denmark names Canadians explicitly under a Nordic arrangement: the 3 months runs from your first entry into Denmark OR any other Nordic country, and time spent in any Nordic country in the preceding 6 months is deducted. This applies regardless of whether you have stayed in another Schengen country prior to entry into Denmark. Denmark publishes indicative funds of about DKK 350 a day in private accommodation or DKK 500 in a hotel, wants a passport valid 3 months beyond departure, and counts both the entry and the exit day. Denmark's bilateral visa waiver with Canada, notified to the EU, has been in force since 1 May 1958 and covers 3 months (all passports).

fields.stay: 90 days from your first entry into Denmark; time spent in Denmark in the preceding half-year is deducted; this applies regardless of earlier stays in other Schengen countries
fields.note: Denmark counts New Zealanders' time from first entry into Denmark rather than pooling it with the rest of Schengen, and deducts any time spent in Denmark in the preceding 6 months. This applies regardless of whether you have stayed in another Schengen country prior to entry into Denmark. ETIAS is not in force as at August 2026; the Entry/Exit System is live. Denmark holds a 1.1.1949 bilateral visa waiver agreement with New Zealand allowing 3 months, listed by the European Commission as an extension-of-stay agreement (all passports). Danish Immigration Service states 3 months counted from first entry into Denmark, less any time spent there in the preceding 6 months

Schengen. Hungary also has a bilateral visa waiver agreement with New Zealand, signed on 7 March 2000, allowing up to 90 days in Hungary even if you have already spent 3 months in the last 6 in the Schengen area, if you leave the Schengen area before entering Hungary, do not leave Hungary for other Schengen countries during your stay and leave the Schengen area from Hungary. ETIAS is not yet in operation; no start date announced. The Entry/Exit System is live.

Apply at least 72 hours before travel; valid 180 days from issue. It does not extend your visa-free stay. Not needed if under 16 or transiting for up to 3 days.

fields.note: An International Visitor Permit is issued free on arrival to everyone except New Zealand and Australian passport holders — 31 days, not the 90 days New Zealanders get, so don't read across from a New Zealand source. You need proof of onward travel, sufficient funds, accommodation details and a passport valid 6 months. The total stay is capped at 2 months without a departure of 6 months or more.

fields.stay: Less than 3 months (extendable once by 3 months, to 6 months in total)
fields.extension: Cook Islands Immigration, Avarua (one further 3 months, to 6 months in total)

fields.note: No visa before travel — a New Zealand Visitor Permit is issued free at the border on the arrival card. The 3-month entitlement is tied specifically to New Zealand or Australian citizenship; other nationalities get 31 days. You need proof of onward travel and sufficient funds, and must be a genuine visitor not intending to work or study.

South Korea is one of the 25 countries on Vietnam's 45-day unilateral visa-exemption list (Group 1, valid through 14 March 2028); stay was extended to 45 days from 15 August 2023, regardless of passport type/purpose. An e-visa (90 days, multiple entry) remains available for longer or multiple-entry stays.

Germany is one of the 25 countries on Vietnam's 45-day unilateral visa-exemption list (Group 1, valid through 14 March 2028); stay was extended to 45 days from 15 August 2023, regardless of passport type/purpose. An e-visa (90 days, multiple entry) remains available for longer or multiple-entry stays.

Vietnam's e-visa is open to citizens of all countries and territories, so Canadians are covered by an inclusive rule rather than a named list. Choose single or multiple entry when you apply. Apply from outside Vietnam before travelling; processing is 3-5 working days. The 90 days is the maximum — the period actually granted is what appears on the issued e-visa.

New Zealand is NOT on Vietnam's visa exemption list — that covers 25 countries (to March and August 2028), and New Zealand is in neither group. So you need an e-visa, which Vietnam now issues to all nationalities. Apply online before travel; processing takes 3-5 working days after payment.
